sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Long-Haul Bonded Highway Freight Transport under TIR Carnets

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 2010 de 2019 (AML/CFT and beneficial ownership framework), Ley 1121 de 2006 (prevention of money laundering and financing of terrorism), Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales), Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolución 285 de 2020, and Circular 009 de 2016 of the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF); constitutional and commercial basis in Código de Comercio, articles 98-110.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the Non-Resident Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry and Notary in the Shareholder's Country of Origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the origin country; if the origin country is not a party to the Apostille Convention, Consular Legalization through a Colombian embassy or consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted by the Foreign Shareholder to the Colombian Incorporation Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction where the grantor is located
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the origin country's competent authority; Consular Legalization if the origin country is not an Apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport and Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration of each Natural-Person Shareholder, Director, and Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing civil registry or notary; UBO declaration subscribed before a Colombian Notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostilled or Consular-Legalized notarial copy of foreign civil documents, translated into Spanish by a certified translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Clean Criminal Record Certificate and PEP/Sanctions Background Certification of each Director and Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Police or judicial authority of the country of residence; Colombian Procuraduría General de la Nación for Colombian residents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign certificates; notarized Spanish copy for domestic certificates

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-listing screening of all UBOs, directors, and legal representatives against the U.S. OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian UIAF lists, and domestic Colombian PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for Politically Exposed Persons, including foreign and domestic PEPs, their family members and close associates, under Ley 2010 de 2019 and Circular 009 de 2016 UIAF. All screening results, source-of-funds declarations, and PEP questionnaires must be notarized where applicable and retained for at least 10 years after termination of the commercial relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (https://www.rues.org.co) and Cámara de Comercio's Registro en Línea platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Spanish or in a clear Spanish-alphabet transliteration of a foreign-language name. Names must be unique within the RUES national registry, must not confuse the public, must not misstate the entity type, and must include the mandatory suffix 'S.A.S.' for a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada. Conflicting trademarks are checked through the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and is non-extendable; if expiry occurs, a new reservation request must be submitted. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a 'recurso de reposición' before the issuing Cámara de Comercio within 5 business days from notification of rejection, under Código de Comercio articles 159-160. If denied, a second administrative appeal may be filed with the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 business days; the applicant should include corrected alternative names and a trademark-search certificate in the appeal package.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible as the registered-office address for a Colombian S.A.S. only when paired with a physical Colombian address for service of process and a Colombian-resident legal representative. For cross-border TIR trucking under ISIC 5221, virtual-office-only registration is not acceptable because the Ministry of Transport requires a registered operational domicile, fleet parking address, and cargo terminal access.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 25-35% annual probability of unannounced inspection of the registered office by DIAN, the Superintendencia de Sociedades, or the Chamber of Commerce. For cross-border trucking operations, road-side and terminal inspections of vehicles, TIR carnets, and cargo average 60-75% per 100 international trips.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry name reservation and incorporation certificate (pre-registration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff under Decreto 1074 de 2015 and annual commercial registry fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Digital notarization of S.A.S. bylaws (documento privado autenticado or escritura pública if required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notario Público — Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fee schedule; approximately USD 20-35 for basic SAS incorporation instruments

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of foreign corporate and individual documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille Authority of the Origin Country / Colombian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille and consular fee schedule; market benchmark of USD 20-40 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified Translator registered with the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 10-15 per translated page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO and AML/KYC screening, beneficial-owner filing and PEP/sanctions diligence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades / external compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee for low-risk standard corporate structures; statutory UBO filing has zero government fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation due-diligence legal memorandum and incorporation closing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for a low-risk, single-purpose S.A.S. in transport support services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Libro II, Título I, and Decreto 2044 de 2021 on digital commercial registration
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), under the regulatory supervision of the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private instrument of incorporation) filed through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); a notarial Escritura Pública is required only if real estate is contributed
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for S.A.S.; shareholders set the subscribed capital freely and contributions may be deferred up to two years; no escrow account is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. 1. Share Subscription. The Board ratifies the subscription of the authorized shares, their class, and the payment schedule stated in the incorporation deed. 2. Registered Office. The Board adopts [registered address, city, Colombia] as the statutory registered office and instructs the Legal Representative to record it before the Cámara de Comercio and the DIAN. 3. Officers. [NAME] is appointed Legal Representative with broad authority, and [NAME] is appointed Compliance Officer responsible for transport, environmental, and tax filings. All acts performed prior to this resolution are ratified, and this resolution remains in force until expressly amended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability and homonymy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio through the national RUES portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES platform, open a pre-registration file, and submit three proposed company names for the homonymy verification. The system confirms that no identical or confusingly similar trade name is already registered in the Chamber's records.
required_dossiers: Valid government-issued identification of each incorporator (national ID card or passport for non-residents)
Three proposed corporate names in Spanish
Basic due diligence questionnaire of the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is rejected, the RUES result indicates the conflicting registration; the applicant may immediately resubmit an alternative name. The homonymy consultation itself is free of charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and commercial registration of the constitution document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Registro Público Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing full bylaws (share classes, legal representative powers, duration, arbitration clause). Have the signature of each founding shareholder authenticated before a notary or by sworn declaration. Upload the document to the RUES system, pay the registration fee, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución with authenticated signatures (two counterparts)
Formulario RUES and Registro Único Tributario form
Proof of registered office address (lease agreement or public utility bill)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a deficiency notice or query, the applicant must correct the documentation and resubmit within the peremptory term indicated by the registry; re-filing is processed under the same priority once all omissions are cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification, NIT assignment, and municipal industry and commerce registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) via the MUISCA portal and the municipal treasury (Secretaría de Hacienda)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the pre-registration form in the MUISCA portal to obtain the NIT and the Registro Único Tributario (RUT). Select the corporate income tax regime and, concurrently, register with the municipal treasury for the Industria y Comercio tax (ICA) and with the Caja de Compensación Familiar for payroll-related obligations.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued within the last 30 days
Authenticated copy of the incorporation deed
Address and activity details of the operating establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or queries the RUT application, correct the relevant data fields in MUISCA and resubmit the revised form electronically; a same-day administrative resolution is available through the DIAN call center and virtual assistance channel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Road freight transport authorization and TIR cross-border registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Transporte — Dirección de Transporte y Tránsito, executed through RUNT (Registro Único Nacional de Tránsito) and territorial offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the enterprise habilitation as a public cargo road transporter. Register each truck in the RUNT system; each vehicle must pass the technical-mechanical and emissions inspection, obtain SOAT civil liability insurance, and secure the Tarjeta de Operación. For TIR operations, file a separate request with DIAN as the competent customs authority endorsing the national guaranteeing association and obtain the TIR Carnet allocation.
required_dossiers: Company certificate of existence and legal representation with NIT
RUNT vehicle registration and property card for each truck
SOAT policies and complementary cargo liability insurance
TIR Carnet application and guarantee approval letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry of Transport objects to the application, the applicant may correct the deficiencies and re-file, or file the administrative appeals available under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo (reconsideration appeal before the same authority and subsidiary appeal to its superior).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Transporte — Dirección de Transporte y Tránsito, with operational registry through RUNT (Registro Único Nacional de Tránsito)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Habilitación para la Prestación del Servicio Público de Transporte Terrestre Automotor de Carga and the per-vehicle Tarjeta de Operación; cross-border service additionally requires DIAN endorsement of the TIR guarantee under the TIR Convention of 1975

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible and the local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) with territorial jurisdiction
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category of minimum environmental impact — registration of mobile sources (Registro de Fuentes Móviles) with mandatory Revisión Técnico-Mecánica; full EIA report not required where no stationary industrial facilities are constructed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Vehicular emission limits per Resolution 910 of 2008 (CO, NOx, hydrocarbon and diesel opacity limits by model year); wastewater discharges from maintenance areas must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 maximum permissible load limits; hazardous residues (used oils, filters, batteries) managed per Resolution 374 of 2009 with chain-of-custody manifests
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) for the operations terminal covering extinguishers, evacuation signage and fuel storage; structural load verification of cargo handling areas; annual vehicle safety inspection; SG-SST occupational health and safety program registered with the ARL with risk assessment and emergency response plan approved by civil defense authorities

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – National Tax and Customs Directorate; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co (electronic services portal: https://muisca.dian.gov.co)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian SAS, the legal representative must obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) as part of the company's registration procedure. This is effected by submitting the Certificate of Incorporation and the tax/legal registration form through the DIAN virtual office (MUISCA) or at an authorized DIAN branch. The SAS is then enrolled in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and a permanent NIT is assigned. Non-resident service providers receiving Colombian-source income are also mandatorily registered in the RUT through a local proxy/tax representative and are attributed an NIT. An electronic signature certificate (Decreto 2242/2015) must be obtained for DIAN web-service clearance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch pass-through election for corporate entities. However, qualifying SAS companies may elect the simplified taxation regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación – SIMPLE) under Law 2010 of 2019 if turnover and other conditions are met; a group of related entities may elect to file consolidated income tax under the régimen de consolidación; and exporters may elect to claim periodic VAT refunds rather than awaiting credit carry-forward. For customs, the TIR carnet procedure is an authorized customs transit election that does not alter VAT classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A – Colombian SAS legal entities are unconditionally subject to VAT registration as responsables de IVA (régimen común) regardless of turnover. For natural persons qualifying for the simplified regime, the annual VAT threshold is 3,500 UVT (annual UVT value adjusted; approx. COP 180 million for reference).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory under Resolución DIAN 000165/2023: all VAT-responsible taxpayers must issue factura electrónica de venta through authorized technology providers, transmitting each invoice to the DIAN in real time via web services/API. Each accepted invoice obtains a CUNE (Código Único de Numeración de Factura) and must carry a digital signature (QR + CUDE). Fiscal clearance is thereby effected ex ante to operation, with no printed non-electronic invoice allowed for B2B/B2C operations concerning export freight services.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated (excluded) from VAT. For cross-border trucking under TIR, the service of international land cargo transport performed for a foreign recipient from Colombian territory to a foreign destination qualifies as an export service under Article 481 of the Estatuto Tributario and Article 99 Integrity TIR Doctrine, provided (i) the service is directly linked to goods leaving Colombia, (ii) the transport provider is a Colombian SAS with RUT enrollment, (iii) an export declaration is lodged with DIAN customs, and (iv) the transport is documented under a valid TIR carnét. Foreign exchange receipts must be repatriated within 180 days from the date of export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación / DEX) validated by DIAN
TIR Carnet (Carné TIR) evidencing the bonded overland transit
Bill of Lading / Cargo Manifest (Regular Manifest or LCM) for road freight
Packing List (Lista de Empaque) and commercial invoice
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) from a Colombian bank
Certificado de Facturación Electrónica de Exportación (if applicable)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit the export dossier under fiscal-risk criteria. Failure to substantiate zero-rating gives rise to the obligation to pay VAT omitted plus monthly default interest. For deliberate export misdeclaration, the sanction for 'exportaciones ficticias' (fictitious exports) is a penalty of 160% of the tax evaded, alongside retroactive clawback of VAT refunds and prohibition to offset credits in subsequent periods; criminal tax fraud liability may attach under Article 108 of the Código Penal. Statutes of limitation for DIAN assessment are five years, extendible where the return has not been filed or presents anomalies.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (BANREP) is the central bank and principal foreign-exchange authority, acting through its Junta Directiva; the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises the authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMC) and enforces AML/CFT and SAGRILAFT rules; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) controls customs and the TIR Carnet at the borders. The binding legal instruments are Law 9 of 1991, Decreto 1735 de 1993 (Régimen de Cambios Internacionales), Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83 of BANREP, and the SFC's Circular Básica Jurídica.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is convertible under a floating exchange-rate regime with a market reference rate (TRM - Tasa Representativa del Mercado) published by BANREP. Current-account proceeds from cross-border TIR freight (export of transport services) are freely convertible and can be kept in COP or USD at an IMC, but all flows exceeding USD 10,000 per calendar month per concept must be channeled through an IMC. Capital-account foreign direct investment (FDI) requires no prior license, but every inbound equity contribution must be registered with BANREP (Formulario No. 4 - Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) within 6 months of disbursement; full USD or EUR contributions are permitted. Dividend and capital repatriation to non-resident shareholders is allowed once the FDI registration is updated and the applicable withholding is settled (the statutory dividend withholding for non-residents currently being 10% on distributions sourced from taxed earnings, subject to treaty relief, with no separate remittance tax). Practical hurdles are documentary rather than discriminatory: each foreign payment over the de minimis threshold must be reported and backed by invoices and transport documentation; there is no forced conversion of export FX into COP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia does not impose forced surrender or mandatory conversion of export currencies. Instead, the law imposes a collection-and-channeling obligation: (i) proceeds from international freight services must be collected within 6 months of the invoice date or completion of service, extendable once for a further 6 months with the IMC's authorization; (ii) the full monthly amount exceeding USD 10,000 per concept must be channeled through an IMC; (iii) collection must be declared on Formulario No. 1 - Declaración de Cambio por Servicios, Transferencias y Otros Conceptos using the official code for international freight services; (iv) the exporter must retain the underlying transport contract, CMR/TIR Carnet manifest, commercial invoice, SWIFT confirmation and the foreign debtor's proof of payment for at least 5 years. Non-compliance, late collection, or channeling through non-IMC entities attracts exchange sanctions (multas cambiarias) under Law 9 of 1991 and Circular DCIN-83.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI intake and BANREP registration) + Operational Account + USD-denominated account + fuel-card clearing facility
Operational Account + Trade Finance and Documentary Collections
Operational Account + COP/USD Derivatives and Hedging Collateral Accounts
Operational Account + Cross-Border Cash Management Module
Operational Account (driver payroll and mass payments)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary treasury rail. Colombian SEDPE-type digital lenders (e.g., Movii, Nequi, Lulo) are not IMCs and cannot execute the Declaración de Cambio, channel export proceeds, or support the FDI registration; foreign digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business, Ebury) are not licensed in Colombia for FX intermediation and flows passing through them bypass the mandatory IMC channel, causing compliance denial and declaration of void channeling. A foreign EMI may be used only as a secondary auxiliary rail for non-FX operational card issuing outside Colombia, with settlement via the tier-1 IMC; all core liquidity, FX declarations, foreign investment registration and hedging must remain within the regulated system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permitted under the SFC's digital-KYC provisions in the Circular Básica Jurídica, but in practice tier-1 Colombian banks require a physical client-risk interview of the legal representative (or a formally accredited compliance delegate) at a local branch, especially when foreign shareholders hold more than 25% of the SAS. Apostilled board resolutions and notarized powers of attorney (poder especial) are mandatory for remote signatories; each UBO above the 5% threshold must present passport-level identity verification and an apostilled corporate extract from the shareholder's jurisdiction. Videoconference-only opening is available at certain banks (BBVA and Davivienda) only if the UBOs have an established local banking relationship or the SAS appoints a Colombian resident compliance agent; otherwise a physical visit to Bogotá or Medellín is the safest legally defensible path.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO register contains non-resident shareholders with no NIT, no Colombian economic nexus, and no verifiable source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled corporate registry certificate of the foreign shareholder; passport-color UBO identification; FATCA/CRS self-certification forms; sworn declaration of source of funds; audited parent-entity financial statements for the last 2 years; BANREP FDI registration application; board resolution approving the SAS incorporation and capital schedule; Colombian tax agent appointment (Contador Público and Revisor Fiscal, if required); 3-year business plan and pro-forma cash flow to evidence the origin of capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment pattern showing structured or high-frequency transfers to shell-flagged fuel, toll, or freight intermediaries in Panama, Curaçao, Ecuador, or Peru without a clear cargo nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete counterparty KYC file: commercial registry excerpt, DIAN VAT certificate, bank reference letter, negative OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening, and the underlying TIR Carnet plus CMR manifest and customs transit document physically linking each wire to a specific truck movement; procurement policy requiring electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) and proof of IVA withholding for every cross-border supplier payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive operation alarm: tolls, Venezuelan border expenses, fuel, and emergency driver advances settled in cash or via informal 'pasamaletas' corridors, creating unexplained anomalies in transaction monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy certifying zero cash settlement for fuel and tolls and mandatory use of bank-issued fuel cards and TAG/toll transponders; fuel-card program agreement issued through WEX/Comdata/UTA/Terpel/Primax rails; monthly toll statements from INVIAS and private concessions; per-trip driver cash advance policy with signed custody receipts and fuel consumption reconciliation; cargo insurance policies for cross-border segments; annual internal or external audit report confirming no crypto or informal-value-transfer usage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory transport license not verifiable or dormant: MinTransporte habilitación nacional, RUNT company file, or TIR operator authorization mismatch with the ISIC 5221 business scope.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid MinTransporte resolution granting international cargo haulage authorization; current RUNT company registration showing 'operador de transporte' status; valid TIR Carnet holding certificate issued through the Colombian guaranteeing association (ANALDEX/ICC); vehicle fleet registry with technical inspections and emissions certificates; copy of the SAS bylaws expressly restricted to ISIC 5221; SOAT and international cargo liability insurance policies; DIAN foreign trade authorization for temporary imports of vehicles under TIR.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity contributions must arrive by SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank routing) directly to the tier-1 IMC in the corporate name of the SAS; SWIFT field 70 (Remittance Information) must state: 'APORTE CAPITAL SOCIAL - INVERSION EXTRANJERA DIRECTA - SAS ISIC 5221'. The IMC completes the Formulario No. 4 - Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales with the direct investment code for the real sector, and BANREP's electronic platform (SINEO) is used for the Registro de Inversión Internacional within 6 months of the disbursement. Verification protocol: reconcile the SWIFT wire to the signed capital contribution minutes (acta de asamblea) and the bank's Certificado de Canalización; retain the payment order, SWIFT confirmation, and FDI registration certificate for 5 years. Routing through a personal account, a third-party, or an unlicensed EMI voids the FDI registration and exposes the company to exchange sanctions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Local disbursements: interbank low-value clearing via ACH Colombia (CUD) and bank-issued fuel cards settled through local card rails for domestic fuel, tolls (TAG), repairs, and payroll. International disbursements: SWIFT MT103 for fuel suppliers, toll authorities, border fees, insurance premiums, TIR Carnet fees, and driver payroll in transit countries; MT101/MT202 batch messaging for consolidated payments. Commercial letters of credit (MT700) are the appropriate rail for capital asset imports (tractors, trailers, spare parts) when a guarantee instrument is required, whereas operational payments should use plain MT103 wires to minimize friction. Every foreign payment exceeding USD 10,000 per month per concept must be reported via Formulario No. 1 and paired with the electronic invoice, route manifest, and TIR/CDF transit evidence; deemed FX conversions use the official TRM of the transaction date and the IMC must issue the corresponding Certificado de Canalización.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forward contracts (Forward TRM) with an IMC - requires documentary proof of underlying USD inflow from freight operations (contracts and invoices) and is settled through Formulario No. 1; typically collateralized with a cash margin in COP.

COP/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with SFC-regulated dealers - interbank standard for non-COP obligations, cash-settled in COP against TRM without physical exchange of principal; subject to the same underlying exposure test and master agreement.
USD/COP cross-currency swaps - permissible under the capital-account derivative framework to match the currency profile of USD-denominated external financing for fleet or working capital.
USD/COP options (call/put options on TRM) - allowed for corporate hedging at SFC-licensed brokerage firms, with premium payable in COP and documentation supporting the hedged foreign currency risk.

Interest rate swaps (fixed/floating in COP or USD) - permissible as a treasury overlay for the fleet capex program, executed under an ISDA/CCIL-style master agreement with the IMC and supported by the underlying loan and cash-flow projections.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación Anual de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registration Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March each year for the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts progressive monetary fines under the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; failure to renew for three consecutive years permits administrative strike-off of the commercial registration and subsequent dissolution of the entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros de Propósito General (Annual Statutory Financial Statements Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the shareholders' assembly approval, which must occur by 31 March; final registry deadline is 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit triggers fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and the Cámara de Comercio, plus loss of the company's good standing; persistent omission can lead to suspension of the mercantile registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due by the last weekday of February for the immediately preceding tax year, subject to DIAN's published calendar extensions.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, incomplete, or incorrect filing subjects the company to fines up to 5% of the unreported or misreported amounts; serious or repeated failures may result in RUT suspension and administrative levies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing window in April of each year for the preceding fiscal year; the exact due date is assigned by DIAN according to the last two digits of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delayed filing incurs a monthly penalty of 5% of the tax payable, capped at 100% of the tax due; unpaid taxes attract daily default interest, and continuing default can block the RUT for customs and foreign trade operations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory when the company's gross assets or gross income exceed 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages (SMMLV) in the prior year, or if the SAS issues securities to the public, operates in the financial/insurance sector, or belongs to a group required to present consolidated financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Grupo 1 entities apply full International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); small and medium entities apply IFRS for SMEs, in accordance with Decreto 2420 de 2015.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each year-end and prior to registering any share transfer in the Libro de Registro de Accionistas, the SAS must confirm and update its ultimate beneficial owner(s) with the DIAN under the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF). Share transfers, including those involving non-resident shareholders, become effective against the company and third parties only after inscription in the shareholders' ledger and, when applicable, in the commercial registry.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General rate 35% for tax years 2022 and forward. Available preferences: 25% additional tax deduction for qualifying research and technological development (RD) investments; 100% deduction for certain donations to social and environmental projects; VAT exemption for the import of capital machinery used in road freight; zero-rated export of international transport services (0% VAT); no sector-specific CIT exemption for ISIC 5221.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 (Declaracion de Renta y Complementario) filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA web portal. Ancillary schedules: Form 2276 (threshold information), Form 2281 (transfer pricing study filing). Submission requires digital signature (CEP) of the legal representative and certified public accountant.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending 31 December, the return is due in April of the following year according to the final two digits of the taxpayer's NIT. The 2025 filing window spans approximately 9 April to 21 April. A monthly installment (2nd quaterly) based on estimated tax may be due in February, June, October and December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian NIT only; do not combine foreign shareholder data. If the entity is a branch of a non-resident corporation, also mark the foreign parent's country and NIT in the supplementary identification box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable year (periodo gravable) in format YYYY.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Colombian statutory fiscal year, which coincides with the calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary gross income, including international haulage revenue, TIR Carnet service fees, demurrage charges and fuel surcharges billed to foreign principals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue when earned; convert foreign currency at the Colombian Central Bank certified market rate at invoice date. Evidence must be kept for inspection for five years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income, including dividends received from Colombian entities and income from foreign permanent establishments with a Colombian participation exemption where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders have no direct entry on this line; only the domestic S.A.S. files these figures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, including driver salaries, truck depreciation, fuel purchases, tolls, TIR Carnet customs fees, freight insurance and cross-border maintenance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible costs must be supported by invoices issued to the Colombian entity. Payments to foreign affiliated subcarriers must be at arm's length with TP documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total deductions, including royalties, interest, repairs, administrative expenses, and VAT on depreciable assets when treated as a cost.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border interest and royalties paid to non-residents are deductible only if withholding tax has been applied. DTA benefits require prior submission of a Certificate of Tax Residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (renta liquida gravable) after subtract costs, deductions, exempt income and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify no non-deductible expenses of foreign parent are allocated to the Colombian entity. The 12-year carryforward is applied from prior years in chronological order.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 35% of Line 76.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax credits for foreign taxes paid on the same income are claimed using the Form 210 section 'foreign tax credit' without exceeding the Colombian CIT generated by the foreign revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax discounts (descuentos tributarios) such as RD investment and donations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: None of these credits apply to a non-resident-only activity unless expressly authorized; maintain qualification certificates before claiming.
If the return results in a balance in favor, the S.A.S. may offset against other tax debts or request a refund through Form 350. Non-residents may not self-assess refunds.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax, with a minimum fine equal to 10 UVT for zero-tax returns. Late payment monthly default interest accrues at the current DIAN rate (approx. 2.1% per month for 2025). Filing with errors or incorrect data: 5% of the tax due (minimum 10 UVT) for understatement, inflated to 100% for non-informational violations. Refusal to file electronically may trigger a penalty of up to 15,000 UVT.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% of gross dividends distributed to a non-resident shareholder out of Colombian-source profits already subject to the 35% corporate income tax (E.T. Art. 246-2). Dividends paid from exempt untaxed profits are subject to a 20% withholding, unless the beneficiary is a resident of a DTA-limited tax jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a lower DTA rate, the foreign shareholder must deliver, prior to the payment date: (i) a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the revenue authority of its jurisdiction of residence for the calendar year of the dividend; (ii) a written statement of beneficial ownership and lack of treaty abuse under Decree 2444/2018; and (iii) a declaration confirming the shareholder has had a taxable presence in the residence jurisdiction for at least 183 days. The Colombian payer submits the TRC and supporting evidence to DIAN through the MUISCA portal and applies the reduced withholding rate (typically 5-10%). If the certificate is not delivered in time, the statutory 10% rate applies and a refund may be pursued via Form 350 within the statutory term.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory remittance withholding: interest paid to non-residents: 15%; royalties for the use of IP, know-how, operating software and truck-equipment leasing: 15%; technical assistance and consulting fees: 15% (10% for some services with DTA). Under Colombia's treaties, interest commonly reduces to 5-10%, and IP royalties to 7.5-10%. For leasing of trailers, containers and telematics equipment under a finance lease, royalties may be recharacterized as lease payments subject to a 15% rate unless the residual ownership and substance of the transaction indicate a loan.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: For tax year 2024, the Local File is compulsory where the taxpayer's gross income exceeds COP 21,179,250,000 (450,000 UVT; UVT 2024 = COP 47,065) AND transactions with related parties exceed 150,000 UVT; or when the taxpayer has assets exceeding 450,000 UVT and carries out related-party transactions. The Master File is required when the MNE group's consolidated gross income exceeds COP 70,597,500,000 (1,500,000 UVT). A Country-by-Country Report is filed by ultimate parents with consolidated group revenue above COP 1,547,460,000,000. TP return is Form 2281, prepared in COP.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a Caribbean ESR statute, but fiscal substance is essential for treaty access and anti-abuse protection. A cross-border trucking S.A.S. must evidence real premises, a local board or commercial mandate, own or leased fleet, local drivers with Colombian labor contracts, fuel and maintenance accounts, TIR Carnet operational control, and commercial decision-making in Colombia. DIAN may apply the sham transaction doctrine (E.T. Art. 55) or the GAAR to disregard an entity lacking substance, reattributing income to the true foreign principal. In addition, CFC rules may attribute passive income of controlled foreign corporations to Colombian shareholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underreporting cross-border freight revenue received in foreign bank accounts, inflating fuel or maintenance invoices, paying drivers in cash without labor registration, or shipping misdescribed goods under TIR Carnet to reduce customs declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty: 4 to 9 years imprisonment under Colombian Criminal Code Art. 402 plus a fine of up to 1,000 UVT. Tax assessment: official liquidated tax, penalty of 160% of the evaded tax, default interest, cancellation of customs and TIR authorization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives are solidarily liable with the company under E.T. Arts. 793-794. Travel bans, attachment of personal assets, freezing of bank accounts, disqualification from managing corporations for up to 5 years, and in severe cases preventive detention are available.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file the Local File/Master File for intercompany TIR haulage transactions, charging a foreign related truck franchise an artificially high or low margin, paying exit tolls to a connected logistics office without TP study, or retroactively preparing inflated documentation after a DIAN inspection has begun.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Official primary adjustment plus secondary adjustment; penalty of 2% of the value of each undocumented transaction with a floor of 300 UVT and a ceiling of 3,000 UVT (E.T. Art. 658-3); default interest at the monthly DIAN rate; possibility of criminal prosecution if concealment is proven.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signs the TP certificate and the accountant who underwrites the study may be personally liable for 100% of the penalty if they knowingly use false data. Professional suspension by the Central Board of Accountants and a personal travel ban can be imposed. An international arrest warrant may follow in cross-border fraud cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an S.A.S. with no physical fleet, no Colombian employees, no separate bank accounts, no route decision-making, and merely processing invoices to transfer profits from Colombian shippers to a foreign parent in a zero-tax jurisdiction, while the TIR trucks belong to a foreign affiliate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the entity under E.T. Art. 55, include 100% of the revenue in the true Colombia-based taxpayer's income, apply the 35% tax plus a 100%-160% fraud penalty, cancel the company's NIT and impose fines of up to 100,000 UVT. The company may be struck from the Cámara de Comercio registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors become personally liable for taxes, penalties and interest. In addition, criminal proceedings may be opened for false accounting and document forgery; directors face up to 8 years imprisonment, a travel ban, and forfeiture of assets under Colombia's confiscation regime (extinción de dominio).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding tax evasion on profit repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends or made-up foreign service fees to a non-resident shareholder without applying the 10% dividend WHT, declaring the payment as 'TIR transport cost reallocation' to a non-resident affiliate without actual services, or failing to submit a beneficial ownership declaration to avoid the 10% statutory tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The paying company is liable as withholding agent for 100% of the unpaid withholding tax, plus monthly default interest and a penalty of 160% of the amount not withheld (E.T. Art. 651). The Colombian manager may also be charged with the misdemeanor of non-compliance with withholding obligations and receive a custodial sentence under Art. 402.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid WHT. Their personal assets shall be attached; they are subject to a travel ban until payment and may be extradited to Colombia if the beneficiary of the illegal distribution resides overseas and the conduct constitutes cross-border tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using TIR Carnets to move cash from illicit cargo (gold, emeralds, narcotics proceeds) by issuing false electronic CMRs; charging freight for shipments that do not exist; accepting payments through unregulated razor-thin fuel cards with undisclosed commissions; or deliberately misdeclaring cargo value in the TIR computerized transit system to move liquidity between Colombia and Ecuador/Venezuela.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Laundering of assets (Ley 1766/2016, Art. 323 C.P.): 10 to 15 years imprisonment and a fine of 50,000 minimum wages (approx. COP 130 billion). The entity loses its Aduana cart authorization and TIR Carnet accreditation; operating permits are suspended; assets are subject to confiscation and an 'extinción de dominio' action.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face pretrial detention, preventive seizure of personal bank accounts and properties, international travel bans, and a pending arrest warrant if they leave the country. On conviction, they serve the term of imprisonment, must pay civil restitution to the freight clients and the State, and are permanently disqualified from holding a commercial leadership position in any Colombian company.
